company.value: Airtable is an AI-powered app-building and digital-operations platform. Its website says it has 700 employees across five offices and that 500,000 organizations build on Airtable.

funding.value: Airtable announced a $735M Series F on December 13, 2021, bringing total investment at that time to $1.36B and placing its pre-money valuation at $11B. The round was led by XN and included investors such as Franklin Templeton, J.P. Morgan Growth Equity Partners, Salesforce Ventures, Silver Lake, and T. Rowe Price-advised funds.

hiring_signals.value: Airtable’s company site states that it has 700 people across five offices and directs candidates to open roles. Its careers search result also describes AI fluency as an expectation for most roles, indicating an AI-oriented operating environment.

likely_use_case.value: Airtable is likely evaluating an SDR pre-call research workflow that collects account information, synthesizes it into structured briefs, and makes the output usable in a governed operational workflow. This aligns with Airtable’s stated focus on agents handling manual work, AI embedded in recurring business processes, and connecting governed enterprise data to departmental workflows.
